module: Editor extension that provides a multiline 'Text Editor' window to modify the text content of a scene object field (e.g. a long field of an object). It registers by exposing editor.newTextEditorInstance(objIds, fieldName). The Ok button applies the value via objectHistoryActions.changeObjectFieldWithUndo (undoable), Cancel closes without changing anything.
notes: If several objects are passed, the initial field is empty (the text is only prefilled for a single object); the entered value is then applied to all the ids.
A new instance deletes any existing instance that shares an object id.
The declared logTag is 'editor_scene_tree' (copied from another module, no visible effect).

onEditorGui.desc: Hook called every frame of the editor interface: creates/displays each open Text Editor window, with a multiline input area and Cancel/Ok buttons. Removes the instance when the window is no longer visible.

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: publishes editor.newTextEditorInstance.

onSerialize.desc: Serialization hook (Lua reload): returns a copy of the open instances without the text buffer (textInput).

onDeserialize.desc: Hook called after reload: recreates one instance per entry of the saved state.
